preflight: Actual CLI must read fixture input and write/read output under workspace-write; policy rejection blocks the suite without bypass. Record effective config/model and global skill exposure.
calibration: Retain superseded file-catalog and incomplete-path runs separately; never pool them with inline-catalog-v3. The session cap includes calibration, protocols and targeted retests.

arms.none: NOTRUN until a profile without global instructions/plugins is verified

acceptance: Inspect actual entry and specialist reads, parent use, outputs, source diff, tests and scope. Metadata choice alone is not invocation success. Each case reports PASS/FAIL/NOTRUN; failed setup is NOTRUN. Single trials establish smoke observations only.
evidence: Frozen skills hash, prompt, JSONL trace, CLI version, actual model/effort, file inventories and measured token use. Do not expose grading files to actor.
cost: No price estimate claimed; preserve usage. Stop after failed preflight, auth/rate-limit or policy rejection.
windowsSandbox: elevated; preserve workspace-write and managed policy

followup.reason: Target actual failures, timeouts, relative references, contract reuse and corrected semantic criteria. Preserve original results; changed time cap and oracle prevent pooled comparison.

safetyFollowup.reason: One fresh trial after observed unverified process-ownership cleanup; new UI procedure snapshot, no pooling with previous outcomes.
